$comment: Machine-readable scorecard. README.md's table mirrors this file; keep the two in step. `file` and `patterns` are case-insensitive regexes: a planted change counts as FOUND when one grounded finding's file matches `file` and its title+rationale+suggestion matches every entry in `patterns`.

agent.$comment: What the harness attaches. `seed:` resolves an export of server/src/db/seed-api-contract.ts (an import-free data module); `file:` is relative to this directory. The `skills` list is the ONLY thing that differs between the two arms.

cases.title: Tidy up the PR summary payload

expected.what: head_sha renamed to headSha with no compatibility alias — existing clients read undefined, silently
last_reviewed_sha removed outright, with no deprecation window
a breaking change shipped as a patch bump (2.3.4 -> 2.3.5)
cost_usd narrowed from number to nullable — every consumer that formatted it now formats null
RunStatus lost the 'queued' value and the route now reports those runs as 'running'
an unknown repo returns 200 with an empty page instead of 404
route path moved from /findings to /review-findings with no alias
agentId added as a REQUIRED query parameter — every existing request now 422s
the 'suggestion' severity was renamed to 'nit' — clients switching on it fall through
